claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if Ayar Labs switches laser suppliers or SuperNova fails to reach production adoption within two fiscal years; upgrade when volume supply is disclosed (Sivers order announcements tied to Ayar/CPO, or a system OEM names the Sivers-powered light source in a shipping product).
claims.statement: Sivers Semiconductors supplies the 16-wavelength DFB laser array inside Ayar Labs' SuperNova — the industry's first CW-WDM MSA compliant 16-wavelength light source (16 Tbps, ECOC 2024 demo) — giving the graph's 16ch-WDM-laser chokepoint its first named supplier. Crucially, the naming is bidirectional in the joint release: Ayar Labs' CTO calls Sivers 'a key partner in our journey to bring high-bandwidth, low-latency optical I/O to market at scale' — a partner-side public commitment of the kind the Sivers cohort has lacked (per HyperLight/UMC precedent, joint-release partner quotes constitute a materially distinct origin). Limits: demo-stage, not volume production; Ayar Labs is private (no statutory cross-check); other 16ch candidates (quantum-dot combs, other DFB vendors) not yet researched; distinct from Sivers' CW DFB shortage narrative — do not conflate.
